courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 運輸機氣動外形風洞驗證
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」推進到「備援負載需求是否相容」，最後以「輸入機率不確定度的揭露」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from OR logic for either triggering failure through Whether backup capacity matches load to Disclosing uncertainty in probability inputs. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 飛機系統故障樹分析
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」推進到「備援負載需求是否相容」，最後以「輸入機率不確定度的揭露」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from OR logic for either triggering failure through Whether backup capacity matches load to Disclosing uncertainty in probability inputs. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「把故障邏輯、共因與可驗證假設分開」為主線，在飛機系統非操作故障樹工作台中依序完成任一故障觸發的OR邏輯、暴露分母與事件率、備援負載需求是否相容、診斷殘差的替代原因、組態變更後故障樹更新及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Separate fault logic, common causes and verifiable assumptions in a Non-operational aircraft-system fault-tree bench, progressing through OR logic for either triggering failure, Exposure denominators and event rates, Whether backup capacity matches load, Alternative causes of diagnostic residuals, Fault-tree revision after configuration change, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
